name: planning-object-format
goal: Planning operation reads cache only full ids of the repository's verified object format; refs shaped like the other width and unknown formats are read fresh.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: a225 planReads cached any 40- or 64-hex name. In a SHA-1 repo a branch named a*64 moved and rev-parse kept the old commit (root probe staleBranchRead true). Cause: width guessed, object format never verified.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Guard test/plan-reads-format.test.ts (4260c3c1) on the a225 implementation: 4/4 fail: both moved branches stale, an unstated format cached once, planGit stated no format.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: planGit states the verified object format (rev-parse --show-object-format); planReads caches only full ids of that width; unknown format caches nothing. Guard: real SHA-1/SHA-256 matrix in planning-artifacts and the normal package test.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: planGit objectFormat metadata; planReads immutable() by stated width; port fixture states sha1, new unknown/other-width port test; scenario test plan-reads-format mapped; AGENTS.md and local skill rule.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same guard 4/4 on the fix; port 6/6; real fixture 2/2; normal planning bun run test 50/50 at 20 s; five supervised checks passed, counts equal; root probe on fix staleBranchRead false.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated copy: a225 planReads and planGit restored, unchanged guard 4/4 fail; fix restored, 4/4 pass; guard bytes identical in the copy.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
Process retro: the acceptance gap that let a width guess through is closed by a durable rule and a format matrix.
steps.evidence: a225 introduced the both-width guess. Mocks used only 40-hex SHA-1 and short ids while review trusted the 64-hex claim. Earliest miss: acceptance never named the object namespace. AGENTS/skill rule plus the format matrix prevent the class.
